# High-Grade Corporate Bond yields
yield_feb_1943 = 2.68
yield_feb_1944 = 2.65
yield_jan_1945 = 2.58

# Benchmark yield
benchmark = 2.60

# Calculate absolute differences
abs_diff_1943 = abs(yield_feb_1943 - benchmark)
abs_diff_1944 = abs(yield_feb_1944 - benchmark)
abs_diff_1945 = abs(yield_jan_1945 - benchmark)

print(f"Yield Feb 1943: {yield_feb_1943}%, Diff: {abs_diff_1943}")
print(f"Yield Feb 1944: {yield_feb_1944}%, Diff: {abs_diff_1944}")
print(f"Yield Jan 1945: {yield_jan_1945}%, Diff: {abs_diff_1945}")

# Average deviation (mean of absolute differences)
avg_deviation = (abs_diff_1943 + abs_diff_1944 + abs_diff_1945) / 3
print(f"\nAverage Deviation: {avg_deviation:.4f} percentage points")
print(f"Rounded to 2 decimal places: {round(avg_deviation, 2)}")
EOF
